cites.quote: take your beer out to the track!

t0024-01.gloss: A traffic citation follows a venue access closure while a race-day purchase goes unused.
t0024-01.rival_reading: The venue could have closed that lane after an ordinary race incident, with a patrol citing a late driver afterward; the appeal cannot establish a wider order.

t0024-02.gloss: A trial-related closure conflicts with an event that remains advertised.
t0024-02.rival_reading: A response crew may have ordered routine grounds treatment while the event remained on the board; the refund says nothing about why access was restricted.
